Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the third step (the Planner's analysis after the second WebSurfer search), the Planner hallucinated the content of the search results. It stated that the "Britannica result confirms Norris Bradbury was the director," but the provided search result text explicitly stated: "J. Robert Oppenheimer was the director of the laboratory at Los Alamos." The Planner incorrectly attributed Oppenheimer's role to Bradbury and subsequently concluded the wrong answer (Bradbury instead of Oppenheimer).
